problem: A recovery collision return can be classified as qualifying merely because its state contains RETURN and its own run is DONE, even when that attempt explicitly performed no substantive work and only points to another recovery; this can make dependency evidence SATISFIED without validating the referenced qualifying pair.
acceptance: non-substantive collision/superseded/boundary returns cannot independently satisfy a dependency
a reconciled recovery return may satisfy only through an explicitly validated referenced qualifying RETURN+DONE pair, or remains non-qualifying evidence
fixtures cover collision DONE, boundary DONE, true candidate DONE, and missing referenced pair
derived readiness reports the exact substantive evidence pair used and blocks ambiguity
no source queue status or Current/Human Accepted/Served authority is mutated
title: Harden dynamic readiness against collision-only RETURN+DONE pairs
mission: Make dependency readiness disposition-aware. A DONE run paired with a collision-only, superseded or boundary return must not independently prove prerequisite completion. If a reconciliation return delegates to another attempt, validate and report the referenced substantive qualifying RETURN+DONE pair explicitly; otherwise keep the dependency blocked. Add mixed-attempt fixtures derived from the live Page Thread recovery race and preserve source queues and authority boundaries.

regression_prevention.reason: Prevents collision/recovery bookkeeping from being mistaken for substantive prerequisite completion and silently unlocking dependency-gated integration or stress work.

incident_repair.reason: The live Page Thread recovery race produced a DONE collision-only attempt whose RETURNED_* state currently passes the generic qualifying-return predicate despite declaring zero product work.

unblock_value.reason: A trustworthy dependency compiler is a prerequisite for safely activating local integration, multi-surface integration, stress and production-readiness lanes after concurrent recovery races.

fail_if: a DONE collision-only or superseded attempt independently yields SATISFIED dependency evidence
a reconciliation return can delegate to a missing, non-DONE, negative-terminal or mismatched external pair and still activate readiness
mixed attempts are collapsed by newest-wins or first-success semantics without preserving conflicting or non-substantive lineage
the fix mutates source queue status or promotes Current, Human Accepted or Served authority
falsification.pass_if: True substantive RETURN+DONE evidence still satisfies dependencies; collision/superseded/boundary attempts remain non-qualifying unless an explicitly referenced substantive pair is validated; exact evidence attribution survives mixed attempts; and all authority/source-queue boundaries remain unchanged.
